events.subtitle: Miles Davis & John Coltrane Centennial
events.factual_description: Strathmore and Washington Performing Arts present Terence Blanchard and Ravi Coltrane on Saturday, November 21, 2026 at 8:00 PM in The Music Center at Strathmore for a Miles Davis and John Coltrane centennial program. The presenters explicitly describe the concert as a bold reimagining rooted in the legacy of Davis and Coltrane rather than a nostalgic reenactment.

sources.note: Official event page confirming date, 8:00 PM time, venue, presenters, centennial concept and ticket availability.
Exact album page for Terence Blanchard's Absence, useful as a reference for his modern approach to reinterpreting a major jazz legacy.
Exact album page for Ravi Coltrane's Spirit Fiction, a strong reference for his own compositional and improvisational identity.

en.why_it_matters: This is stronger than a tribute-night premise. Blanchard and Ravi Coltrane are both major contemporary bandleaders with direct but very different relationships to the Davis/Coltrane lineage, and the presenters explicitly frame the program as a living reimagining rather than repertory nostalgia. The tension between inheritance and individual voice is the event.
en.trip_verdict: Yes for the DMV. This is an S-tier local date: culturally specific, musically open-ended and rare enough to protect the evening around it. It would also be worth a regional trip for someone following living jazz masters rather than tribute repertory.

es.why_it_matters: Esto es bastante más fuerte que una simple noche de homenaje. Blanchard y Ravi Coltrane son dos líderes contemporáneos mayores con relaciones directas pero muy distintas con el linaje Davis/Coltrane, y los propios presentadores plantean el programa como una reimaginación viva, no como nostalgia de repertorio. La tensión entre herencia y voz propia es el verdadero evento.
es.trip_verdict: Sí para el DMV. Es una fecha local de nivel S: culturalmente específica, musicalmente abierta y suficientemente rara para proteger la noche alrededor de ella. También justifica un viaje regional para quien siga a los grandes maestros vivos más que a los conciertos-homenaje.
